name: intruder
description: Query and manage your Intruder targets, issues, scans, attack surface and AI pentests.
long_description: Connect Claude to [Intruder](https://www.intruder.io/) to ask about your targets, issues, open ports and TLS certificates, start or cancel scans, manage scan schedules, see AI pentest findings, and start retests and release tests. Requires an Intruder API key: see [Creating an access token](https://developers.intruder.io/docs/creating-an-access-token).
